_about: The official example spaces (plan §4 Space): a link page, a portfolio and an event page, owned by the official OpenVibe account and published from this folder. scripts/seed-official-spaces.js creates and publishes them; running it again changes nothing unless --revise is given. The pages are adaptations of the Space kit's site-links, site-portfolio and site-event templates (templates/spaces/), with real OpenVibe content.

spaces.name: OpenVibe links
spaces.description: Every OpenVibe site in one place: streams, chat, games, the tools and the places that write it all down.
